svg.aria-label: vibeguard scanning a demo app and reporting problems

g.text: $ vibeguard scan demo-app
CRITICAL
PAY-001 Stripe webhook without signature check
app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts:6
> if (event.type === 'checkout.session.completed') {
Why: This webhook acts on Stripe events without checking Stripe's signature, so anyone can
send a fake "payment succeeded" and get the product for free.
Fix: Read the raw body and call `stripe.webhooks.constructEvent(body, signature,
webhookSecret)` before trusting the event.
SEC-002 Supabase service-role key in browser code
components/AdminTable.tsx:4
> const admin = createClient(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!, process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_R
Why: This code runs in the browser, and the service-role key skips every Row Level Security
rule, so anyone can read and change all of your data with it.
Fix: Use the anon key in the browser and move anything that needs the service-role key into
a server route or edge function.
DB-001 Supabase table without Row Level Security
supabase/migrations/20250101000000_init.sql:1
> create table profiles (
Why: Table `profiles` has no Row Level Security, so anyone with your public anon key can
read and change every row.
Fix: Add `alter table profiles enable row level security;` in a migration, then add policies
that limit rows to their owner.
HIGH
3 critical · 4 high · 0 medium · 1 low · 8 files in 0.01s
